    Quantum Mechanics II

    Graduate Course, University of Iowa, Department of Physics and Astronomy, 2026

    The most up to date information will be available on the UI ICON page.

    • Syllabus / Reading List / Course Introduction

    Notes:

    • Review Notes
    • Time Evolution
    • Green’s Functions
    • Variational Method
    • WKB Method
    • Time-Independent Perturbation Theory
    • Hydrogen Review
    • Hydrogen Fine Structure
    • Time-Dependent Perturbation Theory
    • Interaction Picture and Dyson Series
    • Rabi Oscillations
    • Intro to Scattering Theory
    • Simple Scattering Calculations
    • Scattering Formalism and Born Series
    • (Complex Integration Refresher)
    • Scattering Applications
    • Identical Particles
    • Second Quantization
    • Fermi Gas
    • Relativistic Quantum Fields (in class)
    • Dirac Equation (in class)

    Homework Assignments:

    • HW 1: Probability densities and currents (solutions)
    • HW 2: Variational method for anionic hydrogen (solutions)
    • HW 3: WKB quantization conditions (solutions)
    • HW 4: Relativistic correction to hydrogen (solutions)
    • HW 5: Hyperfine splitting including orbital angular and Zeeman effects (solutions)
    • HW 6: Rabi oscillations and the rotating wave approximation (solutions)
    • HW 7: Preliminary to Scattering Theory (solutions)
    • HW 8: Breit-Wigner Resonance (solutions)
    • HW 9: Scattering and Identical Particles (solutions)
    • HW 10: Exchange Force (solutions)
    • HW 11: Scalar Field (see written feedback)

    Exams

    • Midterm 1 (solutions in class)
    • Midterm 2 (solutions in class)
    • Final exam 1

    Review Problem Sets:

    • Problems 1) Schrödinger’s equation in different bases (solutions)
    • Problems 2) Time evolution (solutions)
    • Problems 3) Propagators (solutions)
